captions.detailed: This 3D model features a rigid road bike fork and steering assembly. It includes a tapered black steerer tube passing through a central headtube sleeve with light grey headset spacer rings at both ends. Above the headset, a black threadless stem extends forward to clamp a classic drop-bar handlebar, secured by a rectangular faceplate with two silver bolts. The fork blades curve forward and taper down to flat dropouts. The steering assembly (handlebar, stem, and fork) rotates smoothly around the vertical steering axis relative to the fixed headtube.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a road bike steering assembly. The model should include a fixed central headtube sleeve with light grey headset spacers, a rotating fork with tapered curved blades and flat dropouts, and a threadless stem clamping a black drop handlebar with a front faceplate secured by two bolts. Ensure the steering assembly is set up to rotate about the vertical steering axis.
captions.factory: The code defines a fixed headtube part using a main cylinder and two light grey spacer cylinders at each end. The steerable assembly is modeled as a child part connected via a continuous revolute joint along the vertical Z-axis. This rotating assembly is constructed by combining a central steerer cylinder, a custom-swept fork crown and curved blades that taper to flat dropouts, a forward-extending rectangular stem, and a swept drop-bar handlebar complete with a front faceplate clamp and two small cylindrical bolts.
